test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the value of tan 10°.tan 25° .tan 45°.tan 65°.tan 80°
solution:
Given

tan 10° tan 25° tan 45° tan 65° tan 80° 

Concept used

Tan (90 - θ) = cotθ 

Calculation

⇒ tan (90 - 10) × tan (90 - 65) × tan 45° × tan 65° × tan 80° 

⇒ cot 80° × cot 65° × 1 × tan 65° × tan 80° 

∴ Ans = 1
